change_triggers: A clear deterioration in consumer-tech coverage or a new controversy before the cutoff
views.thesis: Sentiment is steady rather than washed out or euphoric, with no major controversy identified; this supports a neutral view. GDELT tone is unavailable, so evidence for a stronger sentiment call is insufficient.

change_triggers: Export-control headlines intensify materially or enterprise/cloud coverage turns broadly negative
views.thesis: Constructive enterprise and cloud coverage gives Microsoft a modestly positive sentiment bias, while export-control headlines limit conviction. Sentiment does not appear clearly stretched or washed out.

change_triggers: Export-control coverage eases materially or shifts from a dominant overhang to a broader negative narrative
views.thesis: Heavy coverage centered on export controls creates a modestly negative and potentially crowded sentiment overhang. The evidence does not establish capitulation or a washed-out extreme, so the underweight is limited.

change_triggers: Tariff-cost headlines fade and retail coverage improves, or cloud coverage turns decisively negative
views.thesis: Mixed coverage with tariff-cost headlines weighing on retail produces a mildly negative sentiment view. The evidence is not strong enough to call sentiment washed out or materially stretched.

change_triggers: Supply-tightness headlines reverse or energy coverage becomes broadly weaker
views.thesis: Firmer energy coverage on supply-tightness headlines supports a modest positive sentiment stance. There is no evidence that sentiment is sufficiently euphoric to warrant a stronger view.

change_triggers: Drug-pricing review coverage escalates or healthcare coverage becomes constructive
views.thesis: Cautious healthcare coverage tied to drug-pricing review headlines is a modest negative sentiment signal. The evidence does not show a washed-out extreme or justify a stronger underweight.

change_triggers: Input-cost and tariff coverage worsens materially or the mild negative fades into clearly positive staples coverage
views.thesis: Stable staples coverage is tempered by mild input-cost and tariff concerns, yielding a slight negative bias. Sentiment appears neither stretched nor washed out.

change_triggers: Tariff and global-demand headlines become decisively more negative or turn supportive
views.thesis: Industrial coverage is sensitive to tariff and global-demand headlines, creating a mildly cautious sentiment view. The evidence is too limited to identify a clear fear extreme or capitulation.

change_triggers: Renewable-incentive coverage reverses or broader utility coverage becomes negative
views.thesis: Renewable-incentive headlines support a modestly positive tone for NextEra Energy. No evidence indicates that sentiment is excessively euphoric or washed out.

change_triggers: A new controversy emerges or stable staples coverage deteriorates materially
views.thesis: Stable staples coverage and limited controversy support a neutral view, but they do not indicate a stretched or washed-out sentiment setup. GDELT tone is unavailable, leaving insufficient evidence for a stronger call.
